Passimian

Fighting

Alola · Generation 7

Passimian is a Fighting-type Teamwork Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 82.8 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 490.
